bio: Located in downtown Tampa in a tiny space with some seating outside and a small counter inside, this casual concept is all about sandwiches—at breakfast and lunch—as well as a few sides and salads. It's a bright, mood-elevating kind of place where diners come in the morning for the olive and feta sandwich, served on a toasted focaccia bun with a black olive tapenade, fluffy egg, feta, thinly sliced red onion, and roasted peppers. Craving sweet instead of savory? Fresh cinnamon sugar sour doughnuts are a hit (and often sell out). Middays are met with the likes of turkey and cheddar melts with sweet bacon jam that are equal parts hearty and impressive....
